title: The Unseen
subtitle: Every hiding flag the format has, one file each
description: The chapter is a chain you can watch reveal itself. First Light is visible
from the start; the two veils behind it appear one at a time, each revealed by
the one before; and the vault at the end of the chain opens its card only
Off to the side are the three that hide differently. A Quiet Word withholds
its description until it is done. The Hermit is not on the canvas at all
until you have picked up a single ender pearl. The Crossroads fans out into
three roads, and only one of them can ever be completed.
Walk it with /tasked complete and /tasked progress to watch the canvas
change -- the hidden quests appear as their prerequisites become visible,
which is a thing no screenshot of this chapter can show.
